column1: # Helix plasma shield research and selection gauge.

Helix combat units gain regenerating plasma shields (15–40 HP by role). Shields absorb damage before hull and recharge at 6 HP/s after 5 seconds without taking damage. Applies to existing and new units.
column2: 赫利克斯战斗单位获得可再生的等离子护盾（按兵种提供15至40点护盾值）。护盾优先承受伤害，连续5秒未受伤后以每秒6点恢复。对现有和新建单位均生效。
